name: Aikyo Toshiro
source:
The male protagonist, Toshiro doesn't wear his feelings on a sleeve like his sister. Very careful not to reveal too much about himself to others, he keeps his friend group small, with Ryuu and Mikuru closest. He's terrified of what would happen if someone got too close.

Favorite Color: Powder Blue
Blood Type: O+
